feature_space: NumPy-only word unigram/bigram TF-IDF, max_features=2048, smoothed IDF, sublinear TF, L2 normalization; vocabulary fitted only on teaching rows
selection: One fixed candidate; no parameter search or evaluation-driven lesson edits. Preserve any failure.
scope: Synthetic English category pilot; passing point targets does not qualify real mailbox automation. Existing service defaults to review-only.
baseline: Same capped TF-IDF features and fit rows, logistic regression C=1; same conformal fold at alpha=.05

cohorts.fresh: New authored holdout, same author as teaching, not blind or independent production evidence
cohorts.upstream: Previously seen upstream cases, retained as regressions only
